comment: Machine-readable chip index (#98). Single source of truth for which STM32
families the SDK supports, shared by the build and by stmtool.
Before this file the same knowledge lived twice: as sixteen identical
'not yet supported' stubs under sdk/cmake/families/, and as a hardcoded
chip list inside stmtool's shell completion. Adding a family meant editing
stm32_families.cmake reads 'supported' to decide whether to include
sdk/cmake/families/<family>.cmake or to fail with a readable message.
stmtool reads 'chips' for completion and rejects an unsupported family at
'project create' instead of letting CMake fail mid-configure in Docker.
'chips' lists the concrete part numbers used for completion and CI; the
family file accepts any package/flash-size variant of the listed series.
